ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of care for plants? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of care for plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say care for plants has no place in daily life.
   C. Use care for plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing care for plants.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Early life of the prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Early life of the prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Early life of the prophet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Early life of the prophet has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Early life of the prophet.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Honesty? (1 mark)

6. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick? (1 mark)

   C. Use Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick has no place in daily life.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

8. Which response best shows understanding of Believe in? (1 mark)

   B. Say Believe in has no place in daily life.
